messages.subject: Errors while loading csv data
parts:
Hi, I'm trying to load within ctmmweb some griffon vulture telemetry data (ca. 500k fixes, 68 individuals) stored on PC, and I have received an error message which I'm not able to interpret.
Data have been downloaded from movebank in an Excel spreadsheet format because they need to be filtered, processed, cleaned etc. Then I've converted them in CSV format. While loading this converted csv file I got the error message.:

Minimum sampling interval of NA in NA
Import Error:
<simpleError in telist[[i]] <- DATA[DATA$id == id[i], ]: attempt to select less than one element in integerOneIndex>


Thank you for any help/advice you could provide.
mario posillico
